name: Deep Diplomat
text: You've studied the history of the Deep Current Alliance, and you understand the value of turning an enemy into a friend. When you succeed on a Diplomacy check to Make an Impression against an opponent that's hostile, you critically succeed instead.

name: Deep Resonance
text: Your bond can sustain life at great cost. Once per day, when a bonded ally would die (reaching 0 HP and losing dying), you can sacrifice a prepared spell slot of 4th rank or higher to immediately stabilize and restore them to 1 HP.

name: Deepspeaker
text: You're descended from a long line of deepspeakers, dating back to an ancestor who served as liaison for a linnorm. You've been chosen to carry on the tradition, learning secrets passed down through generations of your people. You become trained in Performance and gain the Impressive Performance skill feat.

name: Defensive Formation
text: Requirements You're adjacent to at least two of your allies. You instinctively understand how your allies act and move, and use that knowledge in the heat of combat to adopt a defensive formation that better shields you from harm. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to AC and Reflex saving throws. If one of these adjacent allies is your bonded partner, that bonded partner gains the same benefit that you do. This benefit lasts until you are no longer adjacent to at least two of your allies.

name: Defensive Gunner
text: You've learned to defend yourself with only a gun, shielding your body and deflecting blows with stock and barrel. Guns you wield gain the parry trait. If an appropriate weapon already has the parry trait, increase the circumstance bonus to AC it grants when used to parry from +1 to +2.

name: Defensive Gunner
text: You've learned to defend yourself with only a gun, shielding your body and deflecting blows with stock and barrel. Guns you wield gain the parry trait. If an appropriate weapon already has the parry trait, increase the circumstance bonus to AC it grants when used to parry from +1 to +2.

name: Defensive Instinct
text: Requirements You can observe at least one enemy and are wielding a shield. Trigger You roll initiative. You've had enough experience in battle to recognize when one is about to start, and though you're rarely the first to attack, you're always on guard. You Raise a Shield.

name: Defensive Programming
text: Your drone gains the Covering Posture action (one action): it enters a defensive stance, and all allies who remain adjacent to your drone gain lesser cover until the start of your next turn.

name: Defensive Recollection
text: You're used to threats coming out of nowhere, and you react by thinking very quickly. Attempt up to three Recall Knowledge checks. If you have any special abilities or free actions that would normally be triggered when you Recall Knowledge, you can't use them for these actions. At 13th level, you can instead attempt up to four Recall Knowledge checks. At 17th level, you can instead attempt up to five Recall Knowledge checks.

name: Defensive-Minded
text: You know full-well the dangers that exist in the modern galaxy when one is unprepared for the worst, even when hoping for the best. You gain the Shield Block general feat. You can move at full speed while using the Defend exploration activity.

name: Defiant Liberation
text: You can leverage your instinctive magical abilities to liberate the body and mind. You gain Clear Mind and Unfettered Movement as 4th-rank arcane innate spells. You can cast each of these spells as arcane innate spells once per day.

name: Defy Gravity
text: You break the bonds of gravity. While graviton-attuned, you gain a fly Speed equal to your Speed.

name: Defy Gravity
text: You break the bonds of gravity. While graviton-attuned, you gain a fly Speed equal to your Speed.

name: Deific Obedience
text: You've dedicated yourself to a deity or pantheon. As long as you follow the edicts and anathema of that deity, you gain their granted 1st-rank spell as a divine innate spell you can cast once per day, heightened to 3rd rank; if you're legendary, the spell is heightened to 4th rank. If you repeatedly break your deity's edicts or perform anathemas, you lose this ability, and it can only be regained with an atone ritual.

name: Delegate
text: Frequency: once per day You know that teamwork makes the dream work, so you delegate your task to a teammate. Choose an ally within 30 feet who can perceive you and direct them to complete a simple task, such as attacking a target, moving to a location, or using an item. The creature becomes for 1 minute and can only use this extra action to Stride, Strike, or Activate an Item. If the target of Delegate completes your direction before the beginning of your next turn, you replenish your use of this feat.

name: Delete Root Access

meta.Prerequisites: ["You have delete in your spell database."]

text: [one-action] If your next action is to cast delete, replace its target with one construct or tech creature. Instead of delete's normal effects, a target of level <= your level - 3 becomes controlled by you (Will save resists). Failure: it's your minion 1 minute (dismissed if you/ally attack it). Critical Failure: 1 hour.

name: Delve Memories
text: During your daily preparations, you can piece together fragmentary memories of your past lives to gain the trained proficiency rank in one skill of your choice. This proficiency lasts until you prepare again. Since this proficiency is temporary, you can't use it to satisfy a prerequisite for a skill increase or a permanent character option like a feat.

name: Demolitions Experience
text: Requirements You're wielding a melee weapon that deals bludgeoning damage. Sometimes the only way to take care of a haywire prototype or malfunctioning doodad is to give it a good old-fashioned wrench-thrashing. Make a Strike with the required weapon against a creature that is glitching. On a hit, instead of dealing the weapon's normal damage, you deal ] damage and reduce the target's glitching value by 1 (or by 2 on a critical hit).

name: Demoralizing Critical
text: You verbally boast before you Strike, further pressing your advantage by rubbing some salt into their wounds. If you critically hit your target, attempt an Intimidation check with a +2 circumstance bonus to [[/act demoralize]] your target.

name: Denial of Safety
text: [one-action] If your next action Casts a Spell with a burst, cone, or line area and no duration, increase its area. Add 5 feet to a burst radius of at least 10 feet; add 5 feet to a cone/line of 15 feet or smaller, or 10 feet to a larger cone or line.

name: Deploy Bunker
text: One action (concentrate): create a 5-foot-wide metal wall adjacent to your drone or turret, or extend an existing wall by 5 feet. The walls are 1 inch thick, 5 feet high, share your exocortex's statistics and Hit Points, and retract if the drone or turret moves.

name: Deployed Static
text: Frequency once per minute You learn to crowd the minds of other creatures with your psychic static and emit it as a protective field. Each adjacent creature attempts a will save against your class DC or spell DC, whichever is higher. Failure The target is Off-Guard against the next melee or ranged attack that you attempt against it before the end of your current turn. Critical Failure The target is off-guard against melee and ranged attacks that you attempt against it until the end of your next turn. Special As a 10-minute exploration activity, you can make any number of allies temporarily immune to this ability for 24 hours. Creatures that can't access telepathy, such as other static mind lashuntas, are immune to Deployed Static.

name: Depth Swimmer
text: You dive into the abyss with ease. You take no damage or penalties from water pressure at any depth, and your swim speed increases to 40 feet.

name: Dermal Spikes
text: Spiky protrusions jut from your body, which you can use to wound your attackers. Your Fortitude DC against Athletics checks to Grapple or Shove you increases by 1. Additionally, you gain the Piercing Spikes reaction.

name: Desert Stride
text: You move through difficult desert terrain without slowing down. You ignore difficult terrain from sand and loose earth and are not flat-footed in such terrain.

name: Desert Thirst
text:
Frequency once per day

You permanently transform up to 10 cubic feet of liquid within 90 feet into sand. Attempt a counteract check to destroy each unattended liquid magic or alchemical item within the area, with a counteract level equal to half your level rounded up and a counteract modifier equal to the higher of your class DC – 10 or your spell DC – 10. A creature within the area can attempt a Will save against the higher of your class DC or spell DC; on a success, they protect all liquids in their possession, but on a failure, you can attempt to counteract the liquids in their possession in the same way as unattended objects. This doesn't affect liquids in a creature's body.

Alternatively, you can choose to grant water instead of taking it. If you do, you instantly create 10 gallons of water. This option is a conjuration and water effect, instead of a transmutation effect.

name: Desert Wind
text:
Frequency once per hour

You call upon the desert wind to blast your foes away and potentially blow sand in their eyes. The wind howls outward from you in a 60-foot cone until the start of your next turn, and Large or smaller creatures in the area must attempt a Fortitude save against the higher of your class DC or spell DC.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature can't move against the wind (meaning they can't move closer to the origin of the cone).

Failure The creature can't move against the wind (meaning they can't move closer to the origin of the cone). They are also knocked Prone, and if they were flying, they are first pushed back 30 feet and take 10d6[bludgeoning] damage.

Critical Failure As failure, except that even creatures who weren't flying are pushed back 30 feet and take 10d6[bludgeoning] damage, and flying creatures are knocked back 60 feet and take 20d6[bludgeoning] damage. Additionally the creature is Blinded for 1 round.

name: Designer Orb
text: Whether you adjusted your diet or used augmentations, you've adapted your foot orb to take on special qualities without compromising the integrity and utility of your original body. You gain the mechanical benefits of the Bouncy Orb, Jeweled Orb, Magnetic Orb, or Hollow Orb bantrid heritage. This does not allow you to take feats or gain any benefits that require a specific bantrid heritage.

name: Destructive Dash
text: Requirements You're in an environment with suitable material to tear up, such as an urban environment. You dash across the battlefield, tearing up your surroundings and toppling nearby objects as you go to make it harder for your foes to maneuver or to give chase. Stride up to your Speed. The squares you move through become difficult terrain. A creature within reach of one of the affected squares can clear the area with an Interact action, removing any difficult terrain you created in the square.

name: Determination Undimmed
text: Frequency once per 10 minutes Requirements Your last action was a skill check that you failed. Your new life is a challenge that you embrace wholeheartedly. You never give up, even in the face of failure. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus on skill checks attempted with the required skill for 10 minutes.

name: Determined Optimist
text: You refuse to give up or give in to despair, even when all seems hopeless. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to saving throws against emotion and fear effects. If you roll a success on a saving throw against an emotion or fear effect, you get a critical success instead. Special You can't select this feat if you have the Heightened Paranoia feat.

name: Devastating Aim
text: Your well-placed shots inflict devastating wounds on your targets. When you Aim, increase the precision damage dice from d4s to d6s.

name: Devastating Aim
text: Your well-placed shots inflict devastating wounds on your targets. When you Aim, increase the precision damage dice from d4s to d6s.

name: Diehard
text: It takes more to kill you than most. You die from the dying condition at dying 5 rather than dying 4.

name: Digestive Outburst
text: You disgorge your stomach to attack your opponents with powerful enzymes. You gain a stomach unarmed attack that deals 1d8 acid damage damage, has the analog and unwieldy traits, and is in the corrosive weapon group.

name: Digestive Spray
text: Frequency once per day You force your body to produce an excess of powerful corrosive digestive enzymes that you can use to spray in a type:cone|distance:30, dealing 7d6[acid] damage (reflex|against:class-spell|basic save against the higher of your class DC or spell DC). A creature that gets a critical failure on this Reflex save is also Sickened 1.

name: Digital Ambassador
text: You are adept at digital communication and networking. When communicating through digital means, you gain a +2 circumstance bonus to Diplomacy and Deception checks.

name: Digital Diversion
text: You can create false digital trails and distractions. You can use Computers to create a digital distraction, forcing targets to divert attention to the false data.

name: Diplomat's Facade
text: You conceal your face behind a mask while in mixed company, showing yourself only among other elves. The blank expression of your mask makes it difficult for others to read into your motives. You become trained in Deception. If you would automatically become trained in Deception (from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in a skill of your choice. You gain the skill feat.

name: Diplomatic Retreat
text: You attempt to smooth over an erupting conflict or at least make one target less likely to hurt you. You Stride twice, then attempt to [[/act make-an-impression]]. If you end your Strides closer to a target, use the outcome one degree of success worse than the result of your check, and if you end your Stride further from a target, use the outcome one degree of success better than the result of your check. Instead of the normal results of Make an Impression, use the following. Critical Success For the next minute, or until you perform a hostile action toward the target or one of the target's allies, the creature takes a –2 circumstance penalty to attack rolls and to its save DCs for any hostile actions that includes you as a target or includes you in the area. Success As critical success, but it only lasts until the end of your next turn. Critical Failure Until the end of your next turn, the creature gains a +1 circumstance bonus to attack rolls and save DCs for any hostile actions that includes you as a target or includes you in the area.

name: Dire Armplates
text: Your armplates have been drastically enhanced with sharp quills that bristle menacingly. While your armplate is raised, you gain a +2 circumstance bonus to checks to [[/act demoralize]]. When you Shield Block using your reaction against a melee Strike, you break off some of the quills, dealing ] damage to the attacking creature (basic Reflex save against the higher of your class DC or spell DC). On a critical failure, the creature also takes ] damage as the quills embed themselves in its flesh. At 12th level and every three levels thereafter, the piercing damage increases by 1d8, and the persistent piercing damage increases by 1d4.

name: Dirty Retort
text: Trigger A creature misses you with a melee Strike. You turn the tables on your attacker, using underhanded tactics to temporarily hinder it, such as throwing dirt in its eyes, shining a light in its face, pulling its coat over its head, or otherwise being a meddlesome nuisance. The triggering creature becomes your choice of Clumsy 1 or Enfeebled 1 until the end of its next turn.

name: Disarming Shot
text: Requirements You're wielding a gun. You attempt to disarm your foe with a well-aimed shot. You Aim and then make a ranged Strike against your mark. If the Strike hits, attempt to Disarm the target using the same ranged attack roll against the target's Reflex DC, instead of attempting an Athletics check. A Disarming Shot counts as two attacks for your multiple attack penalty, but the penalty doesn't increase until after you've used Disarming Shot.

name: Disciple of the Cycle
text: While it pales in comparison to the powers of a true solarian, you are a devoted disciple of the Cycle and can temporarily manifest control over the powers of the cosmos. You gain Entropy Strike and Skyfire Wings as 3rd-rank occult innate spells. You can cast each of these occult innate spells once per day.

name: Disciplined Follower
text: You adapt to new hierarchies with ease and find reassurance in a reliable command structure. When using the Follow the Expert activity in exploration mode, you gain a +3 circumstance bonus if the ally you're following is an expert and a +4 circumstance bonus if your ally is a master. In addition, if you roll a success on your saving throw against a mental effect that would make you controlled, you get a critical success instead.

name: Dishonored Contrarian
text: When the going gets tough, the tough fight tooth and nail to build a better life—literally. Your fellow vlakas might carry hope, dreams, and unending optimism in their hearts, but you've always found it harder to look on the bright side, and you've done some dubious things to get by. Whether you've lied, cheated, stolen, or taken some lives, you know that you did what it took to survive and thrive in a cold and callous galaxy. You become trained in one of the following skills of your choice: Deception, Intimidation, or Thievery. If you select Deception, you gain the Lengthy Diversion skill feat. If you select Intimidation, you gain the Group Coercion skill feat. If you select Thievery, you gain the Subtle Theft skill feat.

name: Disperse!
text:
When you're fully decked out in your Hellknight regalia, just the presence of your fearsome visage drives enemies back. Attempt an check against an enemy within 30 feet who can perceive you.
Critical Success You push your target up to 10 feet away from you. You can Stride after it, but you must move the same distance and in the same direction.

Success You push your target back 5 feet. You can Stride after it, but you must move the same distance and in the same direction.

name: Dispiriting Taunt
text: You demoralize an enemy with precision. When you successfully Demoralize a target, allies who attack that target this round deal 1d6 extra psychic damage.

name: Dissect Recordings
text: You've spent hours going through limdive footage, and now you're an expert at finding hidden details in recordings. You become trained in Computers; if you're already trained, you instead become trained in another skill of your choice. You gain the skill feat. Additionally, when you critically fail your check to Decipher Writing, , or Seek by watching recorded footage, you fail instead.

name: Distant Blur
text: You become a blur when you push yourself to move as fast as you can. When you Stride while Quickened from Need for Speed, you gain concealment until the start of your next turn. As usual for concealment involving an obvious visual manifestation, you can't use this concealment to [[/act hide]] or [[/act sneak]].

name: Distant Feint
text: You're an incredible actor, and you can use your over-the-top bits and dramatic gestures to throw a foe off its game. If you're wielding a ranged weapon, you can Feint against an opponent at a range of 100 feet, rather than just within melee reach. If you succeed, the opponent is Off-Guard against your melee and ranged attacks, rather than only your melee attacks.

text: Requirements Your target is larger than you. You cling to a target with a sticky grasp. Attempt an athletics check against the target's Fortitude DC. Critical Success The target is Blinded until the end of your next turn, unless you move or your target Escapes. If the target moves, you move with them. Success The target is Dazzled until the end of your next turn, unless you move or your target Escapes. If the target moves, you move with them. Failure You miss the target. Critical Failure You miss the target and land Prone.

name: Distracting Gesture
text: Kasathan combat training tends to focus on grace instead of economy of movement. Certain forms and gestures are passed down both for their beauty and their capacity to distract an unfocused foe. Once per turn, when you Switch Hands you can [[/act feint]] as a free action.

name: Disturbing Violence
text: You're a vicious fighter. When you succeed at a melee weapon Strike against a enemy, that enemy can't reduce their frightened condition below 1 until the beginning of your next turn.

name: Dive and Exhale!
text:
Frequency once per day

You launch briefly into the air and dive, releasing your breath around you as you do. You Fly 15 feet straight up into the air, then Fly in a straight line to an empty space of your choice on the ground within 60 feet, breathing around the spot where you land, dealing twice as many dice of damage as normal to all creatures within a 10-foot emanation of the space where you land. You must be able to use your Dragon Breath to Dive and Exhale, and after using Dive and Exhale you can't use Dragon Breath again for 1 hour.

name: Dive Bomb
text: A well-trained maraquoi hunter can launch themself at their prey from any perch, in any direction. You [[/act high-jump]], [[/act long-jump]], or [[/act maneuver-in-flight]] to Fly your fly Speed. If you move at least 10 feet and end in a square adjacent to a target, make a melee Strike or attempt to [[/act shove]] the target. If you rolled a critical success on your Athletics check to High Jump or a success on your Acrobatics check to Maneuver in Flight, your target is Off-Guard to this attack.

name: Dive for Cover
text: When threatened, you can quickly take a dive and find somewhere to hunker down. You Leap, land Prone, and immediately Take Cover, which allows you to hunker down and gain greater cover against ranged attacks.

name: Diverse Schemes
text: You're an efficient multitasker, and you always have more than one goal in mind or scheme on the go. You can maintain twice your Charisma modifier of assets.

text: As a disciple of a god, you wield some of their divine power. You become trained in the listed divine skill associated with the deity and add the listed cleric spells to your spell list and spell repertoire as signature spells. If you were already trained in the listed divine skill, you instead become trained in another skill of your choice. You become bound by that deity's anathema and can receive that deity's divine sanctification.

text: You draw insight from sacred texts. After 10 minutes of contemplation, you can attempt a Religion check to gain a hint toward solving a problem you currently face.

name: Divine Lightning
text: You channel divine power through your attacks, making them more effective against fiends and undead. If you are good, your Dragon Breath and other electricity abilities dependent on your heritage's associated damage type deal good damage to fiends if it is more beneficial to you. If you worship a deity capable of granting a positive font to their clerics, those abilities also deal positive damage to undead if it is more beneficial to you. When facing an undead fiend, the abilities deal either good or positive damage, whichever is better for you. In all cases, the GM determines which is more beneficial.

name: Divine-Etched Shell
text: Your shell is etched with markings that grant you a connection with the underlying truth of the cosmos. Choose one cantrip from the divine spell list. You can cast this cantrip as a divine innate spell at will. You can also cast the Implant Data cantrip as a divine innate spell at will, except when you do, the target becomes "your shell," and data implanted on your shell can be accessed by any creature that knows the G'folian language. A cantrip is heightened to a spell rank equal to half your level rounded up.

name: Do You Know Who I Work For?
text: Throwing your corporation's name around adds weight to your threats. When you use Intimidation to Coerce or Demoralize a target who knows about your corporation, a success becomes a critical success.

name: Doctor in Training
text: You believe a healthy mind and body is integral to a life well lived, dedicating yourself to helping others recover swiftly from illness and disease. You become trained in Medicine. If you would automatically become trained in Medicine (from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in another skill of your choice. In addition, you gain a +1 circumstance bonus on Medicine checks to [[/act administer-first-aid]], [[/act treat-disease]], and [[/act treat-poison]], and if you get a critical failure on one of these checks, you get a failure instead.

name: Don't Touch That!
text:
Frequency once per day

Trigger An ally you can observe triggers a trap.
You give a sharp, panicked reprimand to an unobservant ally. This feat gains the visual or auditory trait, whichever is appropriate for your warning. Attempt a Delve Lore check against the hazard's stealth DC.

Critical Success Your warning comes just in time. You prevent the trap from being triggered, or you delay the activation until the start or end of your next turn (your choice).

Success Your ally gains a +1 circumstance bonus to AC against the trap's next attack, or to their next saving throw against the trap's effects.

Critical Failure Your sharp warning only startles your ally, leaving them Off-Guard against the trap's next attack.

name: Don't You Die on Me
text: You encourage your ally to hang on and keep going, despite life-threatening wounds or other serious injuries that might take them out. Select an adjacent dying ally. Reduce the target's dying value by 1. If this would reduce their dying value to 0, they lose the dying condition, don't increase their wounded condition, and remain Unconscious. The targeted ally then becomes temporarily immune to Don't You Die on Me for 1 hour.

When you use the reaction, the +2 status bonus applies to any recovery checks or saving throw the ally attempts until the end of their next turn, instead of just the triggering recovery check. Whenever you use your Doomsayer's Litany reaction, you gain a status bonus equal to your Doomed value or the doomed value of the triggering ally to attack rolls and saving throws until the end of your next turn.

name: Double Deployment
text: One action: you Deploy Mine twice; both mines must be within 30 feet of one another.

name: Double Detonation
text: One action, once per round: you Detonate Mine twice. A creature in the area of both detonations combines the damage for the purpose of its resistances and weaknesses.

name: Double Draw
text: Routine use of your arms allows you to quickly move held equipment around. You Interact twice to draw stow, or swap items you have up to twice.

name: Double or Nothing
text: You've truly lucked out. Like some of the greatest worlanisi luck manipulators to come before you, you can hold onto your connection with luck even after you've used it. You can use your lucky number twice a day instead of once.

name: Double Tap
text: Requirements You're wielding a gun. You fire two shots at the same target in quick succession. You Aim and then make two Strikes against your mark. Apply the multiple attack penalty normally. If both attacks hit, combine their damage. You add any precision damage only once, to the attack of your choice. Apply the target's resistances and weaknesses only once.

name: Double Tap
text:
Requirements You're wielding a gun.

You fire two shots at the same target in quick succession. You and then make two Strikes against your mark. Apply the multiple attack penalty normally. If both attacks hit, combine their damage. You add any precision damage only once, to the attack of your choice. Apply the target's resistances and weaknesses only once.

name: Down to the Wire
text: Trigger The final action on your turn is a 1-action directive. You act quickly to show your teammates exactly how it's done. Resolve the directive you just issued as though it was a 2-action version instead of the 1-action that you used.

name: Down to the Wire
text:
Trigger The final action on your turn is a 1-action directive.

You act quickly to show your teammates exactly how it's done. Resolve the directive you just issued as though it was a 2-action version instead of the 1-action that you used.

name: Dozens of Cousins
text: You always know where to find family, and family is everything. When you're in a settlement or an area you could conceivably meet another ysoki, you can spend 1 hour asking around to find a cousin of yours. The cousin begins with an attitude of friendly toward you and will grant you simple Requests, so long as they would be reasonable to ask (subject to GM discretion). You can attempt to make a more substantial Request, usually for a favor in exchange. The GM decides the DC based on the difficulty of the favor and the amount of risk it poses to your cousin.

name: Draconic Breath
text: Frequency once per day Beyond emulating dragonkin's energy breath, you've now learned to channel the power of a true dragon, able to spew forth its potent energy. Choose a type of damage that corresponds to a specific dragon. You can exhale this energy as a or that deals ,4d6[persistent,untyped]|options:area-damage]{14d6 damage plus 4d6 persistent} damage of the chosen type (basic reflex save using the higher of your class DC or spell DC). On a critical failure, a target also becomes Frightened 2.

name: Draconic Cantrip
text: You've regained some of your innate magic, which you can use to cast a cantrip from the tradition associated with your heritage. Choose a cantrip from the spell list corresponding to the tradition indicated in your heritage. You can cast that cantrip as an innate spell. As normal, cantrips are heightened to half your level, rounded up.

name: Draconic Haste
text: You draw upon the power that makes your magic from the lux aeterna ritual rapidly adaptable in order to increase your physical speed for a time. You can cast Haste once per day on yourself as an innate spell of your heritage's tradition.

name: Draconic Hubris
text:
Frequency once per hour

Trigger You are about to attempt a saving throw that has a critical failure effect that is different from the failure effect.

Your self image has reached dizzying heights, leading you to believe that nothing can harm you. Roll the saving throw twice and take the better result. However, if you still roll a failure on the saving throw, your sheer disbelief in the possibility of failure spells your undoing, and you get a critical failure instead.

name: Draconic Influence
text: In pursuit of an equal friendship with their dragon neighbors, many ryphorians have learned to take on their large, winged forms. You can cast Dragon Form as a 6th-rank primal innate spell once per day. You must transform into the same battle form each time you cast this innate spell, chosen when you select this feat. When you reach 17th level, you can heighten the spell to 8th rank when you cast it.

name: Draconic Lethality
text: Your draconic body is a weapon. When you select this feat, you gain one of the following unarmed attacks of your choice: claw, horn, jaws, or tail. Each of these attacks is in the brawling weapon group and has the listed damage die and traits. Claw 1d6 slashing (agile, finesse, unarmed) Horn 1d6 piercing (finesse, unarmed) Jaws 1d6 piercing (grapple, unarmed) Tail 1d6 bludgeoning (sweep, trip, unarmed) At 5th level, whenever you get a critical hit with one of these attacks, you get its critical specialization effect. Special You can take this feat four times. Each time you do, select a different attack from the options listed above.

name: Draconic Pride
text:
Frequency once per hour

You are unbeatable, insurmountable, monumental, and more than a mere mortal, so nothing can defeat you. Or at least, in your arrogance, you convince yourself of that. Reduce your frightened condition by 1. For 1 minute, whenever you become frightened, reduce the frightened condition's value by 1. However, breaking your arrogance leads to a catastrophic way of anxiety. If you critically fail a saving throw against a fear effect while Draconic Pride is active, the effect ends immediately and you increase the frightened condition you gain from the critical failure by 1, instead of decreasing it.

name: Draconic Resilience
text: Your draconic heritage strengthens your constitution. You gain 6 additional HP and your energy resistance increases by 2.

name: Draconic Resistance
text: You have revitalized the magical pathways that protect your body from the type of damage you would normally use for your breath weapon. You gain resistance equal to half your level (minimum 1) to your heritage's associated damage type.

name: Draconic Senses
text: You have an impressive sense of smell, passed down through the generations from a dragon ancestor. You gain imprecise scent with a range of 40 feet. The GM might double the range if you're downwind from the creature or halve the range if you're upwind, at their discretion.

name: Draconic Verve
text: You've focused magic on restoring your ability to shake off torpor, making it harder for others to force you to sleep or paralyze you. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to saving throws against effects that would cause the paralyzed condition and effects with the sleep trait that would cause you to fall asleep, and if you roll a success on your saving throw against such an effect, you get a critical success instead. If an effect makes you fall asleep or gain the paralyzed condition for at least 2 rounds, reduce the duration by 1 round.

name: Dragon Breath
text:
You breathe in deeply and release the energy stored within you in a powerful exhalation. Your dragon breath is a 30-foot line, a 15-foot cone, or a 5-foot burst within 30 feet, depending on your heritage, and deals a number of d4s equal to half your level (minimum 2d4) damage of a type depending on your heritage. Each creature in the area must attempt a Reflex saving throw against the higher of your class DC or spell DC. If the damage type is poison, the saving throw is Fortitude, and if the damage type is mental, the saving throw is Will. You can't use this ability again for 10 minutes; starting at level 3, you instead can't use the ability again for 1d4 rounds.

The damage increases by 1d4 at 5th level and every 2 levels thereafter, to a maximum of 10d4 damage at 19th level.

Special If your breath weapon's damage type has a matching trait, your Dragon Breath action gains that trait. For example, if you are a red dragon, your Dragon Breath gains the fire trait.

name: Dragon Lore
text: You know stories of dragons from time immemorial, and those teachings fill you with a pride and presence that can awe other creatures. You gain the trained proficiency rank in Arcana and Intimidation. If you would automatically become trained in one of those skills (from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in a skill of your choice. You also gain the Additional Lore feat in Dragon Lore.

name: Dragon Scent
text: Magic wafts through your nose, restoring the acuity of your sense of smell so you can sniff out nearby thieves and other hidden creatures who don't think to obscure their scent. You gain imprecise scent with a range of 30 feet.

name: Dragon's Endurance
text:
Frequency once per day

You briefly surge your magic through you as a protective force, preventing harm before it can reach you for a short time. You gain temporary Hit Points equal to twice your level that last for 1 round.

Effect: Dragon's Endurance

name: Dragon's Flight
text: You've restored the power to your wings enough to fly at all times! This might not seem like as big a deal to traditionalist dragons, but it's one of the more difficult feats for aeternal dragons, even as your other powers have expanded vastly beyond your original capacity. You have a fly Speed of 25 feet at all times.

name: Dragon's Instincts
text:
Frequency once per day

Trigger You roll initiative using Perception.

Your draconic instincts alert you to danger, making sure you are prepared to react first. Roll initiative twice and take the higher result.

name: Dragon's Tenacity
text: Your mind and body have the resilience of your dragon progenitors. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to saving throws against fear effects, sleep effects, and effects that would cause you to become Paralyzed. This bonus increases to +2 against spells and magic items that have these effects.

name: Dragon's Tenacity
text: You channel magic to increase your sturdiness, not only becoming more capable of absorbing punishment, but pulling adaptive potential from your destiny in order to avoid the first bit of damage you take each day. Increase your maximum Hit Points by your level. During your daily preparations, you gain temporary Hit Points equal to half your level, which last until your next daily preparations or until they're lost.

name: Dragonet Form
text: You can shrink down into a miniaturized dragonet form of yourself. This causes you to shrink to Tiny size and might make your appearance cuter, though you are easily recognizable by anyone who knows what you look like at your normal size. You can remain in your alternate form indefinitely, and you can shift back to your true dragon form by using this action again.

name: Dragonkin Breath
text: Your exhalations are infused with energy, like your dragon ancestors of old. You can exhale a type:cone|distance:15 that deals ceil(@actor.level/2)d4[@actor.flags.pf2e.dragonkinBreath.damageType|options:area-damage] damage ( reflex|against:class-spell|basic save against the higher of your class DC or spell DC). After using this attack, you can't use it again for [[/gmr 1d4 #Recharge it]]{1d4 rounds}. At 3rd level and every 2 levels thereafter, the damage increases by 1d4. Special When you select this feat, choose your breath's damage type and weapon group: acid (corrosive), bludgeoning (hammer), cold (cryo), electricity (shock), fire (flame), piercing (spear), slashing (knife), or sonic (sonic). This choice is permanent. This ability has the trait associated with the type of damage it deals.

name: Dragonkin Lore
text: You're trained in skills passed down through generations of dragonkin. You gain the trained proficiency rank in Athletics and Society. If you would automatically become trained in one of those skills (from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in a skill of your choice. You also gain the Additional Lore general feat for Dragonkin Lore.

name: Dragonkin Weapon Familiarity
text: You wield weapons favored by the Skyfire Legion. You are trained with the skyfire sword, flamethrower, and machine gun. In addition, you gain access to all uncommon weapons with the dragonkin trait. For the purposes of proficiency, you treat any of these that are martial weapons as simple weapons and any that are advanced weapons as martial weapons. At 5th level, whenever you get a critical hit with one of these weapons, you get its critical specialization effect.

name: Drain Blood
text: Frequency once per 10 minutes Requirements A creature within your reach is taking persistent bleed damage, or is Grabbed, Paralyzed, Restrained, Unconscious, or willing. You jab your proboscis into the required creature to consume their blood. Attempt an athletics check against the target's Fortitude DC. You automatically succeed on this check if the target is paralyzed, unconscious, or willing (but you still roll to see if you get a critical success). On a success, the creature becomes Drained 1 (Drained 2 on a critical success), and you gain temporary Hit Points equal to the target's level that last for 10 minutes.

name: Draining Blight
text:
Frequency once per day

You draw moisture from the living creatures surrounding you, using the energy to heal your own wounds. Each living creature in a 30-foot emanation takes 9d10[void] damage, with a Fortitude save against the higher of your class DC or spell DC. Creatures creatures with the plant or water trait or creatures made almost entirely out of liquid (like most oozes) use the outcome one degree of success worse than they rolled. You regain Hit Points equal to half of the highest damage a single creature takes from this effect.

In addition, all non-creature plant life in the area withers and dies, eliminating non-magical undergrowth and any resulting difficult terrain, cover, and concealment. Water is also consumed in the same way, typically lowering any standing body of water fully within the area by 1 foot.

name: Dramatic Blocking
text: Thanks to years of practice, you know how to use every inch of the stage and give a fantastic performance even in tight quarters. While you can act, you aren't Off-Guard to Hidden, Undetected, or flanking creatures of your level or lower.

name: Dramatic Reading
text: You recite a memorable catchphrase or monologue delivered by a famous media character. Attempt a media-lore|against:will or performance|against:will check against the Will DC of a single enemy within 30 feet. You can target up to two targets within range if you have expert proficiency in Media Lore or Performance, four if you're a master, and eight if you're legendary. Critical Success The target takes a –1 status penalty to Perception checks and Will saves for 1 minute. Effect: Dramatic Reading (Critical Success) Success The target takes a –1 status penalty to Perception checks and Will saves for 1 round. Effect: Dramatic Reading (Success) Critical Failure The target is temporarily immune to Dramatic Reading for 1 hour.

name: Dream Sanctuary
text: You can pull a chunk of the ethereal realm of dreams into reality, providing you and allies with a measure of safety. You can cast cozy crashpad as a 3rd-rank arcane innate spell once per day, except it comes with a vendor constructed entirely based on your desires (though once chosen, it can't be changed). You can order items from this attendant, with an item level equal to or less than half your level (rounded up). As long as you pay for these items, they appear at the end of the 12-hour duration or when you Dismiss the spell.

name: Dream Sight
text: You see glimpses of hazy images from dreaming creatures' dreams surrounding the creature, allowing you to potentially guess some of the elements of that creature's dreams. Your dream sight uses your vision, and is ineffective if you can't see. However, the images appear even from an invisible or undetected dreaming creature, allowing you to determine their location and causing them to be merely hidden instead. Dream dragons sometimes use this information to talk with other creatures about their dreams and analyze the underlying feelings that led to the dreams, while nightmare dragons gleefully use the information to perfect their art of nightmares and tap into hidden fears. Once you've glimpsed a creature's dreams, you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to checks to Sense Motive against the creature for the next day, and if the dream was a nightmare, this bonus also applies on Intimidation checks against them. The bonus to Sense Motive increases to +2 if you are a master in Perception, and the bonus to Intimidation increases to +2 if you are a master in Intimidation.

name: Drift Blink
text:
Frequency once per minute

Trigger An enemy's Strike would hit you, and you weren't already Concealed, Hidden, or undetected to that enemy.
You momentarily slip into the Drift, becoming concealed against the triggering Strike. If the flat check for concealment fails, the Strike misses you. After resolving the triggering Strike, you reemerge from the Drift in an unoccupied space adjacent to your original square.

name: Drift Hop
text:
Frequency once per day
You travel across the battlefield via the Drift. You teleport up to a distance equal to your Speed within your line of sight. If you're in the Drift, the distance you can teleport is doubled.

name: Drift Strike
text:
Frequency once every 10 minutes

Requirements Your last action was a melee Strike that critically hit a creature.
You launch the creature you hit with the required Strike into the Drift to reposition it across the battlefield. The creature is teleported to a location of your choice up to a distance of 20 feet from its starting location and within your line of sight. If you're in the Drift, the distance you can teleport the creature is doubled. The creature must be able to fit in its new location, and its new location must be unoccupied. The creature can attempt a save.
Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The distance you can teleport the creature is halved, and it can't be moved to a location that is hazardous or would result in a fall.

Failure You teleport the creature up to the noted distance.

Critical Failure As failure, but the distance you can teleport the creature is doubled.

name: Drift-Touched
text:
Frequency once per day
You were born or gestated inside the Drift, and hyperspace is always a part of you. With a thought, you seize a fragment of the Drift and temporarily transplant it onto the battlefield as an intangible barrier of colorful light. This shimmering field appears within 30 feet and is straight and vertical, stretching up to 10 feet long and 10 feet high. The barrier grants concealment to creatures targeted through it, and it sheds colorful bright light for 10 feet on each side and dim light for the next 10 feet. You can ignore any concealment granted by the barrier. The barrier lasts for 5 rounds.

name: Drop and Move
text: Requirements You're in bipedal posture. You can use the momentum of shifting your form to quickly gallop into battle. You Change Posture from bipedal to quadrupedal and Stride up to your Speed.

name: Drop Tail
text: Trigger You would be reduced to 0 Hit Points. Requirements You have a tail. In an embarrassing act of desperation, you sacrifice your tail to save your life. You're reduced to 1 Hit Point, rather than 0 Hit Points, and don't gain the Unconscious or wounded conditions. Your tail falls off and flails around wildly, distracting your foes. You Stride up to your Speed, and don't trigger reactions due to this movement. Your tail grows back over 24 hours. While your tail is regrowing, you don't have a tail, your Speed is reduced by 5 feet, and you take a –2 status penalty to Acrobatics checks.

name: Dual Aim
text: Your sharpshooter skills improve. You can have two marks at a time instead of one. When you Aim, you can select two marks, rather than one.

name: Dual Aim
text: Your sharpshooter skills improve. You can have two marks at a time instead of one. When you , you can select two marks, rather than one.

name: Dual Attack
text: You can quickly make two Strikes in a row. When you take the Attack action, you can Strike twice (at –4/–8 MAP) instead of the usual –5/–10 progression, but only with weapons in the same weapon group.

name: Dual Bond
text: While some claim you're incapable of forming a partner bond as deep as other dragonkin can, it's undeniable that you have more flexibility and freedom when it comes to bonding. You can maintain any number of partner bonds at once. Your bonded partners don't automatically count as being bonded with one another.

name: Dubious Knowledge
text: Your mind is full of facts of varying reliability. When you fail a Recall Knowledge check, you learn a mix of true and false information about the topic.

name: Durable IMAS
text: You've adjusted your IMAS to tolerate stress more effectively. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to saving throws against effects that would make you Paralyzed or give you a penalty to your Speed, including those that would make you suppressed.

name: Dust Devil Spin
text: You position yourself to rapidly spin your foot orb without moving, kicking up a thick plume of dust. Until the end of your next turn, any creature in your square (including yourself) becomes Concealed, though they can't use this concealment to [[/act hide]] or [[/act sneak]], as normal for concealment where your position is still obvious. If you are in a sterile environment without significant dirt or dust on the floor, you have to instead rely on a reserve of detritus stored in your cilia. You cannot use this action again for 10 minutes, or until you Step or Stride into a dirty square.

name: Dutiful Adherence
text: You ensure that your knowledge in a task is absolute. You gain the Additional Lore feat and the Assurance feat for the chosen Lore. When you forgo rolling a skill check using Assurance for the associated Lore, you receive a result of 11 + your proficiency bonus (instead of 10 + your proficiency bonus).

name: Dwarvatonic Weight
text: Heightened gravity barely affects you thanks to your sturdy body. Ignore the effects of high and extreme gravity on your carrying capacity, falling damage, jumping distance, and Speed. You don't take bludgeoning damage every minute in extreme gravity. Additionally, while in high gravity, your first weapon Strike each round that uses a melee weapon that deals bludgeoning, slashing, or piercing damage gains a status bonus to damage equal to the number of weapon damage dice (or twice the number of weapon damage dice in extreme gravity).

name: Dwarven Gravity Hammer
text: You know how to effectively hurl yourself like a cannonball directly into your opponents. You Stride twice in a straight line, dealing |options:area-damage] damage to each creature in your path ( save against your class or spell DC, whichever is higher). You move until you meet an obstruction or finish Striding twice. The damage increases to 6d8 at level 16 and 8d8 at level 19. Special If you have , enemies have a –2 circumstance penalty to their Reflex saves against your Gravity Hammer in low or zero gravity. You can also instead of Striding, using a creature in the line to Push Off.

name: Dwarven Honor
text: Honor is the pillar of traditional dwarven ideals. When someone Lies to you, you automatically roll a secret Perception check to [[/act sense-motive]] against them. You also gain a +2 circumstance bonus to Diplomacy checks to [[/act make-an-impression]] on creatures that value truth and respect the honor of your word. Special Hryngar culture cares less for honor but teaches to capitalize on its absence. If you have the heritage, you instead gain the bonus to Make an Impression on individuals who value crime and deceit.

name: Dwarven Weapon Familiarity
text: You are trained in battleaxes, picks, and warhammers, and gain access to dwarven weapon critical specialization effects.

name: Dwarven Zero-G Familiarity
text: Dwarves who have spent their lives aboard orbital clanholdings or Star Citadels find themselves at ease in low gravity environments. You aren't or due to being in zero-g. At 13th level, you gain a climb Speed of 20 feet while in low gravity or zero-g.

name: Eager Assistant
text: You love helping your friends and allies achieve their goals. At the start of your turn, you gain one additional reaction, which you can use only to Aid.

name: Eager Combatant
text: Trigger You roll Athletics or Intimidation for initiative. You eagerly stride into battle, giving no thought to the consequences. You Stride in a straight line directly toward an enemy.

name: Early Adaptation
text: You can briefly merge with willing creatures to share a minor ability. Once per day, you can touch a willing creature and temporarily grant them one of your innate abilities for 1 minute.

name: Early Adopter
text: Though cutting-edge technology has only recently arrived in your home world, you've proven yourself to be a natural with new trinkets and devices the moment you get your hands on them. You become trained in Crafting. If you would automatically become trained in Crafting (from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in another skill of your choice. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus on Crafting checks to Recall Knowledge about tech items.

name: Earthbound
text: You are keenly aware of your own limitations with flight without magic to keep your dense form aloft, but these magical insights make it both particularly easy and particularly satisfying to bring other fliers low. You can cast Earthbind once per day as an innate spell of your heritage's tradition.

name: Eat It!
text: Your caustic stomach is the safest place to hide your goods. You Interact to eat an item of 1 Bulk or less. The item takes ] damage every hour it stays in your stomach. You're with a value equal to the total Bulk of items you have in your stomach and can't reduce your sickened value below that total while they remain there. You can regurgitate any number of items as a single action into your hands or your square.

name: Eccentric Infusion
text: Your planar infusions disrupt magical energies, occasionally causing bizarre and unexpected effects instead of the expected result of a spell. Any time a spellcaster casts a spell from a spell slot within either of your planar infusions, they must attempt a Flat check. On a failure, instead of the spell's normal effect, they produce a Wellspring Surge.

name: Eclipse Strike
text: Your attacks create a brilliant eclipse that veil you from the enemy's view. Make a Strike with your solar weapon or your solar flare. On a hit, you create an impressive display of solar energy between you and your foe. Increase the level of cover you receive from your enemy by one step. Lesser cover becomes standard cover, or standard cover becomes greater cover in the case of creatures at least one size category larger than you. This effect lasts until the start of your next turn. Graviton-Attuned For the duration, if you don't have any cover against an attack targeting you, you gain lesser cover against that attack. Photon-Attuned For the duration, if the target you struck provides you cover against an enemy's attack, that enemy takes a –1 circumstance penalty to their attack roll.

name: Eclipse Strike
text:
Your attacks create a brilliant eclipse that veil you from the enemy's view. Make a Strike with your solar weapon or your solar flare. On a hit, you create an impressive display of solar energy between you and your foe. Increase the level of cover you receive from your enemy by one step. Lesser cover becomes standard cover, or standard cover becomes greater cover in the case of creatures at least one size category larger than you. This effect lasts until the start of your next turn.

Graviton-Attuned For the duration, if you don't have any cover against an attack targeting you, you gain lesser cover against that attack.

Photon-Attuned For the duration, if the target you struck provides you cover against an enemy's attack, that enemy takes a –1 circumstance penalty to their attack roll.

name: Efficient Analysis
text: Your penchant for understanding other beings and gathering information allows you to quickly assess anyone before you. You can cast the cantrip as an occult innate spell at will. A cantrip is heightened to a spell rank equal to half your level rounded up. Once per day, as part of Casting the Spell, you can attempt a check as a free action on the target, or a single creature among the targets if you cast it on multiple creatures.

name: Efficient Assistant
text: Frequency once per 10 minutes Helping others comes so naturally to you that you instantly prepare yourself to help your ally with a task. This counts as preparing to help an ally for the purpose of using the Aid reaction. You must still explain to the GM exactly how you're helping.

name: Efficient Craftwork
text: Through thousands of hours spent mastering a craft and hundreds of iterations on the process, you're able to consistently deliver quality results with minimal waste. When Crafting during downtime, if you critically fail a check, you fail instead, and when you succeed, you critically succeed instead.

name: Efficient Motion
text: Time is precious and not to be wasted, and your mastery of efficiency allows you to shave seconds off even the most mundane tasks. You become Quickened until the end of your turn.

name: Effortless Concentration
text:
Trigger Your turn begins.

You maintain your active spells with hardly a thought. You immediately gain the effects of a Sustain action for one of your active mystic spells.

name: Effortless Concentration (Starfinder)
text: Trigger Your turn begins. You maintain your active spells with hardly a thought. You immediately gain the effects of a Sustain action for one of your active mystic spells.

name: Effortless Influencer
text: You've become such a master manipulator that spotting an opening to ply your influence has become second nature. You gain the Assurance skill feat three times for Deception, Diplomacy, and Intimidation. Furthermore, when you succeed at a check with Deception, Diplomacy, or Intimidation, allies within 60 feet who witnessed your success gain a +1 status bonus to the next check they attempt with that skill within 1 minute (or a +2 bonus if your check was a critical success).

name: Effortless Influencer
text: You've become such a master manipulator that spotting an opening to ply your influence has become second nature. You gain the skill feat three times for Deception, Diplomacy, and Intimidation. Furthermore, when you succeed at a check with Deception, Diplomacy, or Intimidation, allies within 60 feet who witnessed your success gain a +1 status bonus to the next check they attempt with that skill within 1 minute (or a +2 bonus if your check was a critical success).

name: Eldritch Bond
text: You channel strange power from beyond this reality, granting creatures in your bond the power to reform their bodies into powerful, aberrant shapes. You gain the Eldritch Bond epiphany spell.

name: Eldritch Bond
text: You channel strange power from beyond this reality, granting creatures in your bond the power to reform their bodies into powerful, aberrant shapes. You gain the epiphany spell.

name: Elebrian Cantrip
text: You enhance your performances with delightful magical tricks, going far beyond normal sleight of hand. Choose one cantrip from the following list: Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.spells.Item.h7IhypLwItepwhou, Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.0zU8CPejjQFnhZFI, Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Qw3fnUlaUbnn7ipC, or Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.pwzdSlJgYqN7bs2w. You can cast this cantrip as an arcane innate spell at will. A cantrip is heightened to a spell rank equal to half your level rounded up. Special You can select this feat more than once. If you do, you must select a different cantrip.

name: Elebrian Lore
text: Your people's dwindling numbers hasn't stopped you from learning everything there is to know about your ancestral past. You are trained in Arcana and Society. If you would automatically become trained in one of those skills (from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in a skill of your choice. You also gain the Additional Lore general feat for Elebrian Lore.

name: Elebrian Magic
text: Your arcane aptitude grows as you learn how to better entrance an audience with magic. Choose one 1st-rank spell from the following list: Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.vLA0q0WOK2YPuJs6, Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.spells.Item.V1cojmrEOWkJ1yPF, Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.i35dpZFI7jZcRoBo, or Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.yV7Ouzaoe7DHLESI. You can cast this spell as an arcane innate spell once per day. Special You can select this feat more than once. If you do, you must select a different spell.

name: Electrical Engineer
text: You specialize in electrical and power systems. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to Crafting checks when working with power sources, electrical systems, or energy-based technology.

name: Electrical Shielding
text: Your body is insulated from electrical attacks. You gain electricity resistance equal to half your level. Additionally, you gain the Redirect Current reaction.

name: Electrify LFAN
text: Frequency once per hour You send currents of electricity coursing through your LFAN, electrifying everything you're holding. Until the end of your current turn, your Strikes deal an additional ] damage per weapon damage die.

name: Electrolocation
text: Your cilia are sensitive to detecting electric signatures of nearby creatures. You gain electromagnetic sense as an imprecise sense with a range of 15 feet. Electromagnetic sense allows you to detect nearby creatures and technological objects, but you might have to use the [[/act seek]] action to find an undetected creature in an environment with too much electromagnetic radiation, such as inside the engine room of a starship or near a powerful source of radio waves.

name: Electrolocation Mastery
text: Your cilia have become even more sensitive to detecting electric signatures of nearby creatures. Your electromagnetic sense becomes a precise sense with a range of 15 feet and an imprecise sense with a range of 60 feet.

name: Electromagnetic Flight
text: Your personal electromotive force is strong enough to propel you. You gain a fly Speed equal to your land Speed.

name: Electromagnetic Hover
text: Your cilia emit an electromagnetic field around your body that causes you to hover ever so slightly above solid ground. While hovering above solid ground, you ignore difficult terrain. Damaging effects originating from the surface of the ground, such as caltrops or an electrified floor, don't affect you, but effects extending far enough above the ground, like moving through a fire, might still affect you, at the GM's discretion.

name: Electromagnetic Whiskers
text: You've honed your whiskers' sensitivity to the degree that you can sense the movement of the weak electric fields emitted by potential enemies. You gain electromagnetic sense as an imprecise sense out to 15 feet. Electromagnetic sense allows you to detect nearby living and technological creatures, but you might have to use the Seek action to find an undetected creature in an environment with too much electromagnetic radiation, such as inside the engine room of a spaceship or near a powerful source of radio waves.

name: Electron Sprinkles
text: Frequency once per day You siphon off a few extra electrons you weren't using to empower your weapon. You can cast Supercharge Weapon as a 1st-rank arcane innate spell once per day, except the additional damage is electricity instead of being the same damage type of the weapon. Casting this spell in this way also fully charges the weapon's battery if it has one.

name: Electroreception
text: Your electrical sense extends to powered objects. Your blindsense (electricity) increases to 60 feet and you can sense the presence of active technological devices through walls up to 5 feet thick.

name: Electrotether Ball
text: By quickly spinning your magnetic orb while channeling primal energy through it, you can create a tether of electricity that can pull objects and creatures across the battlefield, including yourself. You can cast Electrotether as a 3rd-rank primal innate spell twice per day, but the target becomes "one creature, unattended object, or metal structure." If you target an unattended object, you immediately pull the object into your square and can grab the item if you have a free hand. If you target a metal surface, such as the side of a starship or building, you are immediately moved to the structure (this movement doesn't trigger reactions based on movement) and [[/act climb]].

name: Elemental Favor
text: Even though the calling of your blood doesn't lie squarely with the summerborn or winterborn, you feel that you can nudge it in one direction or the other to help protect you. You gain resistance to cold and fire equal to half your level.

name: Elite Drone
text: Your drone becomes a specialized companion (the top of the chassis chain).

name: Elusive Target
text: Trigger A Strike targeting you fails. You move out of the way as you elude your attackers. You Step.

name: Elven Caution
text: Frequency once per day Trigger You roll initiative. You don't trust others and are always ready to move when a situation sours. You Stride up to half your Speed.

name: Emapthic Pulse
text: Your whiskers buzz with energy as empathic pulses collect within them that you can unleash in a burst of intense emotions.

name: Embrace the Magic
text: You understand that the galaxy is a wondrous place full of arcane mysteries and strange phenomena. You can cast the Detect Magic cantrip as an arcane innate spell at will. A cantrip is heightened to a spell rank equal to half your level rounded up. In addition, you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to skill checks to Identify Magic.

name: Emotion Sense
text: You read emotional states keenly. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to Sense Motive and can detect the general emotional state of creatures within your blindsense range.

name: Emotional Defiance
text: Frequency once per hour Trigger You fail a Will saving throw against a mental effect. You refuse to allow others to influence or manipulate your emotions. Reroll the triggering saving throw and use the better result.

name: Emotional Maestro
text: Your ability to detect the emotions of others is unparalleled. Your emotion sense becomes a precise sense with a range of 120 feet.

name: Emotionless
text: Your inhibited or malfunctioning emotional processors make it difficult for you to feel strong emotions. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to saving throws against emotion effects. If you roll a success on a saving throw against an emotion effect, you get a critical success instead.

name: Empathetic Connection
text: Winning friends and influencing people are among the things that humans do best, and you know that objective is best accomplished using your innate magical empathy. You gain as a 1st-rank occult innate spell at-will. When you cast this spell, you can allow the willing target of the spell to impart information to you instead. After you cast this spell, the target is temporarily immune to your mindlink innate spell for 24 hours.

name: Empathetic Healing
text: Your bond with your partner allows you to literally feel their pain, making it easier to treat their injuries. You gain the Battle Medicine feat even if you don't meet the prerequisites, but you can only use it on your bonded partner unless you're trained in Medicine. When you succeed with Battle Medicine or Treat Wounds, your bonded partner gains a circumstance bonus to the number of Hit Points they regain equal to 5 HP at DC 20, 10 HP at DC 30, or 15 HP at DC 40.

name: Empathetic Shout
text: Frequency once per day Trigger An ally within 30 feet takes damage. Many shirrens form especially empathetic bonds with their friends. You shout out to your friend when they're injured, forming a connection that shields them from pain. Your ally takes half the Hit Point damage from the triggering effect, and you take the remainder of the damage. When you take damage through this link, you don't apply any resistances, weaknesses, or other abilities you have to that damage; you simply take that amount of damage.

name: Empathetic Twitch
text: Your whiskers instinctively twitch and provide you with feedback about a target's current disposition. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to Perception checks to [[/act sense-motive]] for targets within 30 feet of you that are not immune to emotion or mental effects.

name: Empathic Conduit
text: You sense others' baseline emotional states from afar. When you feint using Absolute Empathy, you can do so at a range of up to 60 feet, instead of just melee reach. If you succeed, the opponent is Off-Guard against your melee and ranged attacks.

name: Empathic Link
text: You sense the danger your allies feel. You always know the approximate HP and conditions of all bonded allies, and they know yours. If a bonded ally is reduced to 0 HP, you immediately know.

name: Empathic Pulse
text: Your whiskers buzz with energy as empathic pulses collect within them that you can unleash in a burst of intense emotions. You can cast four times per day as a 2nd-rank occult innate spell, selecting a different emotion each time. You can cast vibe check as a 4th-rank spell by using two daily uses of the spell, but you still only project a single emotion when you cast vibe check this way.

name: Empathic Warning
text: You read emotional currents to anticipate threats. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to initiative rolls when you can detect a living creature within 30 feet.

name: Empower Scales
text:
You've directed magic to your scales, restoring a measure of their former sturdiness. Your scales grant you a +1 item bonus to AC and a Dex cap of +4. You are trained in your scales; they do not use your armor or unarmored proficiencies. Starting at 7th level, you can use your unarmored proficiency if it is better.

Furthermore, you can inscribe fundamental and property runes directly into your scales. If you do, potency runes increase your scales' item bonus to AC, just as they normally do for armor. You can also affix a talisman to your scales. If you wear armor of any kind, your fundamental and property runes on your scales don't function, and if you don armor with an affixed talisman while a talisman is affixed to your scales, both talismans cease to function and you must affix them again. Like explorer's clothing, your scales aren't armor, so you can't inscribe property runes that specify a particular type of armor.

name: Empower Wings
text:
Frequency once per round

You've sent enough magic into your wings to begin to restore their original function before the lux aeterna ritual, though it will be some time before they can carry a creature of your mass into the air for long. You Fly. If you don't normally have a fly Speed, you gain a fly Speed of 15 feet for this movement. If you aren't on solid ground at the end of this movement, you fall.

Special You remember flying and catching yourself as you fall, and your wings have become strong enough to attempt to Arrest a Fall even though you don't have a fly Speed.

name: Empowered Mass
text: You've focused your magic on growing your body and strengthening your bones and body structure to handle the increased size. You permanently gain the effects of Enlarge, becoming Large, increasing your reach to 10 feet, becoming Clumsy 1, and gaining a +2 status bonus to melee damage.

name: Empowered Scales
text: You catch periodic glimpses of the immediate future and can use your insight to predict your foes' moves before they make them. Once per day, you can cast Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.XSujb7EsSwKl19Uu or Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Gb7SeieEvd0pL2Eh as a 1st-rank spell. The tradition of this spell matches the tradition of the cantrip you gained from Sigiled Scales.

name: Encode Presence
text:
Frequency once per hour
You instinctively encode your presence, obscuring your identity and scrambling your visual appearance to technological visual sensors. You become Concealed to all technological visual sensors, such as security cameras, ocular cybernetic augmentations, and the visual processors of technological constructs, for 1 minute. As the nature of this effect still leaves your location obvious, you can't use this concealment to Hide or Sneak.

name: Encore
text: Frequency once per day You consistently rehearse your best bits so that you're always ready for an encore. During this turn, the next action you take can be an ability with a frequency of once per day and that you've used only once today. This doesn't allow you to reuse spell slots or abilities from 20th-level feats or features.

name: Encyclopedic Recall
text: Frequency once per round You swiftly calculate and cross-reference several subjects at once. You instantly use up to three Recall Knowledge actions. If you have any special abilities or free actions that would normally be triggered when you Recall Knowledge, you can't use them for these actions. At 13th level, you can instead use up to four Recall Knowledge actions. At 17th level, you can instead use up to five Recall Knowledge actions.

name: Endlessly Adaptive
text: Your varied life experiences let you adapt to nearly any situation. When you gain skill feats using adaptive talent, you gain two additional skill feats. In addition, you can adapt to the day's challenges by spending 10 minutes to plan. If you do, you can reselect the feats chosen with adaptive talent as if you'd made your daily preparations. You can't trade out feats with limited-use abilities that you've already used that day.

name: Enduring Echolocation
text: You perceive your surroundings as much by echolocation as by your other senses. Your echolocation becomes a precise sense to a range of 60 feet (or 120 feet underwater), in addition to the imprecise sense out to 120 feet (or 240 feet underwater).

name: Enduring Exocortex
text: Your exocortex keeps working when you can't: while you have 0 Hit Points or are otherwise unable to act, it remains functional and can take 3 actions per round on your turn (it acts while you're dying or unconscious, but ceases if you die).

name: Energize Jaws
text: When you deliver a telling bite, your jaws leave behind lingering energy, mental after-effects, or poison associated with your breath weapon. On a critical hit with your jaws, you deal 1d4 persistent damage of your associated damage type.

name: Energy Consumption
text: Your body has adapted over to consume the excess energy it uses to shield itself, allowing it to neutralize other forms of energy that could harm it. When you use your Energy Deflection reaction, if the attack was a failure or critical failure, you gain temporary Hit Points equal to your level; you also gain the Energy Shielding feat (selecting a different type of energy). These temporary Hit Points and the Energy Shielding feat last 1 minute.

name: Energy Deflection
text: Trigger You are the target of a ranged attack that would deal at least one type of damage you selected with Energy Shielding. Requirements You're aware of the attack and are not Off-Guard against it. You leverage the magical energy clinging to your body to counter similar harmful attacks. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to AC against the triggering attack.

name: Energy Eternal
text: You know that energy is eternal—changing, shifting, and reforming, but never truly extinguished. Just as you were born from the death of a star, so too are you born again upon your own death. If you would die, your body explodes in a miniature burst of energy, and you're reborn as a microscopic, slumbering novian, which grows to your full size (usually Tiny) over the course of 24 hours. At the end of this time, you awaken fully healed in the space you died.

name: Energy Expulsion
text: Two actions (your turret's array deals energy damage): make a ranged Strike with your turret; on a hit, energy is expelled in a 10-foot emanation or 15-foot cone, dealing damage equal to the Strike to creatures there (basic Reflex vs your class DC).

name: Energy Infusion
text: You infuse your attacks with necromantic or radiant energies from beyond the material Universe. You infuse your attacks with spiritual energy for 1 minute. All weapons you're wielding and your unarmed Strikes become magical and either deal 1 additional spirit damage and gain the unholy trait against living creatures, or deal 1 additional spirit damage and gain the holy trait against undead.

name: Energy Shielding
text: While traversing the Diaspora, you've witnessed countless magical anomalies and survived to tell the tale. This persistent exposure to magical energy has rubbed off on you, leaving traces of magic behind that shield your body from harmful energy. Select one of the following types of energy damage: acid, cold, electricity, fire, or sonic. You gain resistance 5 to that damage type. Special You can select this feat multiple times. Each time you do, select a different energy type.

name: Engineering Specialist
text: You excel at repairing and understanding technology. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to Crafting checks to Repair items. Your Repair attempts restore an additional 2d6 HP.

name: Enhanced Echolocation
text: You've learned to quiet your other senses and focus your attention on your echolocation. The range of your echolocation imprecise sense doubles to 60 feet (or 120 feet underwater), and you gain the Focus Senses action.

name: Enhanced Senses
text: Your natural senses improve with careful practice or through the use of specific techniques. Increase the range of one of your senses by 10 feet if it's a precise sense or by 30 feet if it's an imprecise sense.

name: Enhanced Shell
text: You've enhanced your exoskeleton with cybernetics or biotech to make it even sturdier. The item bonus to AC from your exoskeleton increases to +4. You can use the Install Upgrade activity to install armor upgrades into your exoskeleton; your exoskeleton has two upgrade slots.

name: Enlarge Quantum Field
text: Your quantum field slowly encroaches on reality. Increase your quantum field's radius by 10 feet. Until your quantum field deactivates, once per turn when you Sustain the quantum field, increase its radius by an additional 5 feet (to a maximum of 50 additional feet).
