name: Enlarged Proboscis
text: Your proboscis has become particularly deadly to those around you and is either longer, stronger, or more flexible. Your proboscis gains two of the following traits: backstabber, backswing, forceful, reach 10 feet (counts as two traits), sweep, trip, versatile S. Special If you select reach, you can use the Drain Blood ancestry feat or the Siphon Poison action of the bloodfilter orocoran heritage from up to 10 feet away.

name: Enlightened Rivener
text: You've mastered your anger and can maintain the rivener transformation indefinitely. You permanently become Large, and your reach increases by 5 feet. You can use Enter Rivener State once per hour, rather than once per day. When you Enter Rivener State, your size and reach don't increase, you don't become stupefied, and you don't become Fatigued when the transformation ends. You still gain the bonus to damage.

name: Enlightenment
text: You understand the true nature of your connection and how it stretches across the vast pillars of reality. Your vitality network has a maximum capacity of 200 Hit Points and regains 20 Hit Points at the start of each turn instead of 8. You can bond with any number of willing creatures.

name: Enlightenment
text: You understand the true nature of your connection and how it stretches across the vast pillars of reality. Your vitality network has a maximum capacity of 200 Hit Points and regains 20 Hit Points at the start of each turn instead of 8. You can bond with any number of willing creatures.

name: Ensnaring Vines
text: You conjure plants from every surface to ensnare your foes. You can cast tangling creepers once per hour as a 6th-rank primal innate spell.

name: Entangling Mycelium
text: You allow your spores to spread. The ground in your square becomes difficult terrain for all non-fungi creatures for 1 minute. If you're already in a square affected by Entangling Mycelium, the fungus spreads and all non-diagonal adjacent squares become difficult terrain for 1 minute.

name: Enter Rivener State
text: You embrace your anger, willingly entering a controlled rivener state and maintaining your mental faculties. Your body grows and expands, becoming Large. Your equipment grows with you, but returns to its natural size if removed. Your reach increases by 5 feet, and you gain a +2 status bonus to melee damage. You become Stupefied 1. This transformation lasts for 10 minutes, or until you choose to end it early as a single action that has the concentrate trait. When your transformation ends, you become Fatigued for 10 minutes. At 13th level and 17th level, the bonus damage increases by 2

name: Entomb
text:
Frequency once per hour

You bring forth a crypt of earth to entomb a Large or smaller foe on the ground within 30 feet, surrounding it entirely and blocking it off from other creatures. The crypt has AC 5, Hardness 10, and 40 Hit Points. It's immune to critical hits and precision damage. Disintegrate destroys the crypt instantly. The effects depend on the target's Reflex save against the higher of your class DC or spell DC.

Critical Success The foe avoids being entombed and is unaffected.

Success The foe dodges the center of the crypt, so the crypt has only 10 Hit Points, instead of 40.

Failure The crypt has the normal effect.

Critical Failure As failure, except the foe is also restrained by the crypt and must Escape against the higher of your class DC and spell DC before it can try to break the crypt from the inside. If the crypt is destroyed while the foe was still restrained, the foe is no longer restrained.

name: Entu Spore Caps
text: The fungal caps all over your body release toxic spores when disturbed. Each time you become Grabbed by a creature or an adjacent creature hits you with an attack, you deal ] damage to that creature. This damage increases to 3 at 9th level, 4 at 13th level, and 5 at 17th level.

name: Entu Spore Cloud
text: Frequency once per hour You spew a dense cloud of fungal spores. Plants and fungi are immune to this effect, but all other creatures in a must attempt a fortitude save against the higher of your class DC or spell DC with the following results. Critical Success No effect. Success The creature is Dazzled for 1 round. Failure The creature is dazzled and can see only 10 feet away for 1 round. Critical Failure The creature is Blinded for 1 round.

name: Envenom Magazine
text: Frequency once every 10 minutes You spit venom into the magazine of a weapon you're holding, or a similar ranged weapon held by a willing adjacent creature. Each Strike or use of Auto-Fire with the chosen weapon until the start of your next turn that deals acid, bludgeoning, poison, piercing, or slashing damage, also deals an additional ] damage.

name: Environmental Adaptation
text: Your body contains polymers that you can rapidly reconfigure to resist extreme temperatures. You treat environmental cold and heat effects as if they were two steps less extreme (incredible cold becomes severe, extreme cold becomes mild, and so on). Additionally, you gain resistance equal to half your level to your choice of cold or fire. You can change your choice during daily preparations, as well as with the Instantaneous Adaptation reaction.

name: Envoy Dedication
text: You've learned to lead and inspire like an envoy. You become trained in Diplomacy and in one skill of your choice; if you were already trained in Diplomacy, you become an expert instead. You can use the Directing Strike improvisation once per encounter. Special: You can't select another dedication feat until you've gained two other feats from the envoy archetype. (Prerequisite Charisma 14 shown for reference; not enforced in-app.)

name: Eoxian Resilience
text: Your long association with undead Eox grants partial protection. You gain resistance 3 to negative energy damage and don't need to breathe in low-oxygen environments.

name: Epiphany Surge
text: Your focus spells intensify. When you cast a connection epiphany, you can spend 2 Focus Points instead of 1 to cast it at one rank higher than its base level.

name: Epitome of Calm
text: By exerting absolute control over your emotions, you stay perpetually composed. You diffuse any effects related to emotions that impact you, making you immune to emotion effects.

name: Erudite Offense
text: You use your knowledge about a creature to focus your attacks. Choose a creature within 30 feet of you that you're aware of. Attempt a Recall Knowledge check against that target, following the standard rules for Recall Knowledge with the following additional effect. Critical Success You understand the exact timing and location to strike your opponent. The target is Off-Guard against all attacks that you attempt against it until the end of your next turn. Success The target is off-guard against the next attack that you attempt against it before the end of your current turn.

name: Erudite Strike
text: Frequency once per day Education is a powerful weapon—and so are guns; fortunately, you wield both to devastating effect. Attempt a Recall Knowledge check against a target you're aware of within 30 feet. You can use this result in place of your next attack roll. If you critically fail the Recall Knowledge check, you are overcome with analysis paralysis and become Stunned 2.

name: Esoteric Education
text: For all their practicality, broader fields of study don't capture your imagination when there are more specialized disciplines you might explore. Choose two Lore skill subcategories. You gain the Additional Lore general feat for both skills. Special You can take this feat three times. Each time you do, you gain the Additional Lore general feat for a new subcategory of Lore, and you become trained in one other Lore skill subcategory of your choice.

name: Eternal Devotion
text: Once per month, when you die, you can choose to invoke your devotion to a single willing living creature you know. Your life essence becomes inextricably bound to that creature, letting you survive beyond death. Your body immediately disappears, and after 1 month, you return to life at maximum Hit Points, appearing within 30 feet of the target of your devotion. If the target of your devotion dies, then you immediately die. If you die and choose not to use this ability, your spirit might return as a ghost or other spirit under the GM's control.

name: Ethereal Hoard
text: You focus on your connection with your hoard and send your hoard deep into the Ethereal Plane where few can find it. You can spend 1 minute to send your hoard, consisting of items with a total amount of Bulk up to your level, to the deepest reaches of the Ethereal Plane; you can Dismiss the effect to return your entire hoard to your current location, though otherwise the effect has an unlimited duration. The hoard can't contain any creatures, even if the creature is in an extradimensional space. Time passes normally for the hoard, and the environmental effects of the Ethereal Plane apply to it. Though very unlikely, it's possible for a creature on the Ethereal Plane to stumble upon your hoard. Dragons with Ethereal Hoard often maintain hoards consisting of a few, small items of significant value—rather than mountains of copper or silver coins—so they can send their whole hoard to the Ethereal Plane.

name: Etheric
text: You became a borai through a botched resurrection attempt—perhaps a magic spell was disrupted, a religious rite went awry, or faulty technology went haywire, resulting in your condition. Your soul is loosely tethered to your body, allowing you to temporarily shield your living form from the ravages of the void. You gain the Soul Shield reaction.
